h1: Games to Play When You're Bored
intro: Bored at home, on a break or waiting for something to finish? These are the free online games our players come back to most — quick to start, easy to learn and surprisingly hard to put down.
Every game runs instantly in your browser on PC, Mac, phone or tablet. No downloads, no sign-up: tap a game, play for two minutes or two hours, and come back whenever boredom strikes again.
Play free mahjong solitaire online: match pairs of identical tiles, clear the board and relax with classic layouts, connect variants and fresh daily-style puzzles.
No download needed — every mahjong game here runs in your browser on desktop and mobile, so you can pick up a quick round any time.
Classic Klondike, Spider, FreeCell and more — free solitaire card games you can play instantly in your browser.
Perfect for a calm break: simple rules, endless deals and no sign-up. Works on PC, tablet and phone.

intro: Play chess, checkers, backgammon, ludo and other classic board games online for free — against the computer or a friend on the same screen.
Sharpen your strategy in a few clicks: no installs and no account, just pick a board and start.
Find words, fill crosswords and unscramble letters in free online word games that train your vocabulary.
Great for adults and kids alike — play in your browser on any device, no download required.
Sudoku, 2048, nonograms and other number puzzles to keep your brain sharp. Free to play online, from easy to fiendish.
No pencil needed — every puzzle runs in your browser on PC and mobile.
Swap, match and blast colorful pieces in free match-3 games. Hundreds of levels, satisfying combos and no download.
Ideal for short sessions on your phone or long relaxing runs on your computer.
Aim, shoot and pop bubbles of the same color in free bubble shooter games — the classic arcade puzzle that never gets old.
Plus our own Bubble Wrap: pop an entire planet made of bubble wrap. All free, all instant, on any device.
Search detailed scenes, spot the differences and find every hidden item in free hidden object games.
Relaxing, story-driven and playable right in your browser — no download, no account.
Find clues, solve puzzles and break out in free online escape room games. Every room is a new mystery waiting to be cracked.
Made by the team behind Door 404, a real escape room in Novi Sad — we love a good puzzle. Play instantly in your browser.
Combine two of the same to create something bigger: free merge games full of satisfying upgrades and surprising discoveries.
Play casual merge puzzles and idle merge tycoons online on PC and mobile, no download needed.
Build empires, run businesses and watch the money roll in — even while you are away. Free idle, clicker and tycoon games to play in your browser.
Start small, upgrade smart and come back to bigger numbers every visit.
Squeeze into tight spots, reverse like a pro and master every parking challenge in free car parking games.
Realistic 3D parking simulators and quick puzzle parking games — all playable online with no download.

No install required — get behind the wheel straight from your browser.

From trials to street racing, every game runs instantly in your browser on PC and mobile.

Tune your car, master the handbrake and play right in your browser.

Quick to play on your phone or computer, with no sign-up required.
